model3d.notes: Extradosed unit 86 + 153 + 86 m (infra.global; designer TEDI, client PMU 6), the 153 m span the longest extradosed span in Viet Nam when it opened (press). Prestressed-concrete continuous box girder built by balanced cantilever, haunched (≈5 m deep at the pylons, ≈3 m at mid-span, read from a side-on construction photo; drawn with deck_haunch, G17); main-bridge deck 18.5 m (16 m on the Super-T approaches), 2 motor + 2 mixed lanes. Navigation clearance 120 × 20.5 m, 24.5 m within 40 m of the channel centreline, 2,000 DWT (VTV). Pylons: a single white concrete shaft in the median ('cột bê tông') rising ≈19 m above the deck and widening slightly upward, crowned by a lotus bud ('chóp búp sen', ≈6 m across, white with a pink-red tip and a ≈2 m finial) to ≈29 m above the deck (kinhtedothi 12/2019: 'khoảng 25/29 m tháp'; side photos ≈28–29 m). One central plane of red stays (each position a pair of strands ≈1 m apart, 15 cm sheaths; anchors in a maintenance gallery in the box), 11 per side per pylon, anchored on the shaft over ≈7–18.5 m and on the median ≈14–58 m from the pylon. Below the deck a rectangular pier (≈6 × 8 m) on a chamfered pile cap ≈12 × 23 m just above the water. Deck ≈26 m above the water at the unit ends, ≈28 m at the pylons, ≈28.6 m at mid-span (crest 2.6 m; heights from side photos, set so that the 24.5 m clearance fits under a 3 m girder).

pylon_custom.description: Lotus-bud pylon ('búp sen'): one concrete shaft on the deck centreline, ≈3.4 m across × 4.2 m along the bridge at the deck, widening to ≈4 × 5 m at ≈19 m, then a bud that swells to ≈6 m (19–21.5 m), stays full (21.5–24.5 m) and closes to a point at 29 m above the deck; the top ≈1.7 m is pink-red (finial not modelled). Stays: one central plane anchored on the shaft over 7–18.5 m. Below the deck a rectangular pier ≈6 m along × 8 m across the bridge on a chamfered pile cap ≈12 × 23 m whose top is ≈2.5 m above the water.
